name: tiling
description: Restructure loops into nested tile blocks to improve cache locality and data reuse by fitting computation within cache levels (L1/L2). Divides iteration space into smaller rectangular blocks.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: Vector of tile sizes for each loop dimension. A value of 0 means no tiling for that dimension. Example: [64, 64, 64] for 3D loop nest, [32, 32] for 2D.

parameters.name: operation_tag
parameters.description: Optional tag attribute to identify the target operation. If empty, matches any structured operation (linalg.matmul, linalg.conv_2d, etc.). Useful for selective tiling in multi-operation IRs.
